title: Build Your $100 Million Dream House? Quiz!
script: Could your $100 million dream house truly stand out? Let's test your luxury taste! For your mansion, would you rather have a full-sized indoor roller coaster, OR a private underwater viewing lounge? 5 seconds! Time's up! Roller coaster is wild, but an underwater lounge offers unique tranquility. Did you pick wisely? Next, for relaxation, a zero-gravity meditation room, OR a personal cloud-seeding weather control system for your garden? Decide now! Tough choice! Zero-gravity is futuristic, but controlling weather? That's next level! Finally, entertainment: a holographic AI butler managing your estate, OR a secret underground tunnel system to local hotspots? Go! Convenience vs. exclusivity! How many did you get right? Could your $100 million dream house truly stand out?
comment: Which of these crazy options would you pick for YOUR dream home?
